name: Tax Collectors
overview: Scripture presents tax collectors, or publicans, as individuals often despised by society, yet notably included in Jesus' ministry and fellowship. Jesus called Matthew, a tax collector, to follow Him, demonstrating His grace toward sinners and challenging the Pharisees' criticism of His association with such people. The passages highlight that even tax collectors show love to those who love them, prompting believers to a higher standard of love. Additionally, the payment of tribute money underscores the social and religious context in which Jesus and His disciples operated.
